findings.evidence: `rg` finds the definition at line 427 but no `latticeWeightSublevelFunctor_obj` or `_map`; analogous public functors expose both lemmas, e.g. `Covering/Monodromy/Basic.lean:74,80`.

findings.evidence: The three `@[expose]` grep hits are at `Cube/Sublevel.lean:33` and `Filtration.lean:64,126`; their APIs are supplied at lines 39, 70–82, and 132–171 respectively.
findings.fix: Remove all three `@[expose]` annotations and use their existing membership/`*_def` lemmas in internal proofs that currently unfold them.

summary: The filtration functor lacks the object/map API needed to use it without unfolding, while three underlying definitions unnecessarily expose their bodies despite existing characteristic lemmas.
